{{Quote|Yeah, maybe. My brother was always there for me. It's going to be strange carrying on without him.|Chedd|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[Chedd]]'s '''brother''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. Chedd's brother was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]], causing Chedd to drive himself to the brink of collapse tracking down the snipers responsible.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
